lines.2: 「Four new members at once. Business is booming.」
lines.3: 「Then shall we hold a tea party? Yoppi, tea.」
lines.5: Sato rose from her seat and headed to the kitchen.
lines.6: 「Wow. That whole sequence looked completely natural. Yoppi gets treated like a maid.」
lines.7: The Princess gave an order, and Sato did exactly as she was told.
lines.8: It certainly looked picturesque. There was nothing strange about it at all.
lines.10: 「No, no. Just for today, you're our guests.」
lines.12: As she spoke, she poured black tea into the cups with brisk, practiced movements.
lines.13: She looked thoroughly accustomed to it.
lines.15: She carried the cups over with graceful steps.
lines.16: First, she placed a cup before the Princess without making a sound.
lines.17: Then she served each of us with equal elegance.
lines.19: Even the tea cakes looked expensive.
lines.20: And with a 'Princess' present, it was practically a medieval tea party--
